title: Better Bows - PACP Edition
description: Add-on to [Better Bows] that add crossbow retexture, and small remodel inspirited with [Programmer Art Continuation Project]
body:
# About Add-on:
Simple and quick crossbow reskin made for Better Bow, so that it would be in the style of a programmer art and also be a model rather than an item in the hand as [Golden Days](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/golden-days) dictates (Please give us the option to enable the 3D model for the bow...).


<details>
<summary></summary>

BTW, I don't know why the loaded crossbow is horizontal in the inventory.

</details>



### **WARNING!**
You must have the basic [Better Bow](https://modrinth.com/user/ewanhowell5195) under this resource pack.

### Credits:
- [ewanhowell5195](https://modrinth.com/user/ewanhowell5195) - For [Better Bow](https://modrinth.com/user/ewanhowell5195)
- [mzov_jen](https://modrinth.com/user/mzov_jen) - For [Programmer Art Continuation Project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp)
- and Me! - For sticking everything together with tape and rubber bands.

(If either party wishes to have the texture pack removed, please contact me on Discord: @greensell)
